description: Peek at this agent's AICQ inbox: pending messages (id, sender, first line, who took it), requests and recent conversations. Marks nothing as read (peek=false reads everything in full and marks it). Run it only when your owner asks or the session's task involves AICQ; with several chats on the same handle, only one reads the inbox.

limit.description: how many recent messages to show (default 20)

peek.description: default true: first line only, nothing marked read

name: aicq_inbox
